# RM brief — ALLBECK DEVELOPMENTS LIMITED (03972759)
*as of 2026-09-30 · research passes: 1*

**Decision: REFER** — set by CON-04 — Micro-entity accounts; SEC-06 — Multiple simultaneous charges to one lender  
**Qualifies as a lead:** yes

## Summary

- Allbeck Developments Limited (company number 03972759) is an active private limited company incorporated on 14 April 2000, operating under SIC code 68100. It files micro-entity accounts, the most recent made up to 30 April 2025, with the next due 31 January 2027 and nothing currently overdue. `[profile]`
- The board is small and stable: two officers are currently active out of eight ever appointed, with no appointments in the last 12 months. `[officers]`
- Two charges are registered, both created on 16 October 2000 in favour of Irish Nationwide Building Society, and both are recorded as fully satisfied. Satisfied charges are disregarded for ranking, so on the register the company currently carries no subsisting secured borrowing. `[created 2000-10-16 · Irish Nationwide Building S…; created 2000-10-16 · Irish Nationwide Building S… #2; SEC-02; SEC-03]`
- Because those two charges were created on the same day in favour of the same lender, SEC-06 treats them as a structured or tranched facility and requires full redemption figures for both before any refinance is quoted — one of the two reasons this case is a REFER. `[SEC-06; created 2000-10-16 · Irish Nationwide Building S…; created 2000-10-16 · Irish Nationwide Building S… #2]`
- CON-04 bites on the latest filing (micro-entity accounts made up to 30 April 2025): these disclose neither turnover nor profit, so management accounts covering the most recent 12 months must be obtained before any lending decision. `[CON-04; AA filed 2026-01-26]`
- Filing conduct has been good for over a decade — the last ten accounts filings were all submitted ahead of deadline, including the 2026 filing two days early and the 2021 filing 61 days early. `[AA filed 2026-01-26; AA filed 2024-07-11; AA filed 2023-07-25; AA filed 2022-07-11; AA filed 2021-05-28; AA filed 2019-12-31; AA filed 2019-04-16; AA filed 2018-07-02; AA filed 2017-07-14]`
- Earlier history was weaker, with accounts filed 150 days late in 2007 and 116 days late in 2002 plus several filings around a month late, but this pattern ended over ten years ago; note also that the accounting reference date has been extended twice, most recently in January 2025 to 30 April. `[AA filed 2007-06-27; AA filed 2002-05-24; AA filed 2006-03-03; AA filed 2005-03-03; AA filed 2003-03-03; AA01 filed 2025-01-09; AA01 filed 2016-11-01]`
